title: Dataset profile
description: The per-dataset parameters every data-builder skill and the src/ exporter/validator need. A skill LOADS a profile (or a worked example below) then CONFIRMS each field against the actual file before using it — values here are never auto-applied. Contract documented in wiki/architecture/data-skill-preset-contract.md. The hard platform rules these feed are in wiki/architecture/platform-*.

$comment.description: Optional free-text note carried by worked examples; ignored by the loader.

dataset_name.description: Human label for this dataset/model (one dataset trains one model).

label_column.description: Name of the target/label column. The platform's desktop runner defaults to 'target'; the gesture demo uses 'class' (then pass -t class to the runner).

sensor_columns.description: The sensor-axis columns (one reading per axis per row), e.g. acc_x..gyro_z. Names are author-chosen but must obey the header charset [A-Za-z0-9_-].

session_column.description: Optional Session ID column marking a time-continuous process. Windows do not cross session boundaries; sessions shorter than the window are dropped.

time_column.description: Optional timestamp column. Must be epoch/relative numeric, never a calendar string. Often absent for fixed-rate signal data (time is implicit).

separator.description: Field delimiter. Platform accepts these five; the desktop runner defaults to comma.

sampling_rate_hz.description: Single sampling rate for the whole dataset (Hz). Mixed rates must be resampled to one common rate before upload. ALWAYS record it.

accel_full_scale_g.description: Accelerometer full-scale range in g (e.g. 2, 4, 8, 16). ASK the user up front. Fixes counts-per-g, so the data can stay RAW INT16 (no float conversion - the platform consumes raw) and scale/segmentation can be checked (at rest |acc| ~ 1 g in counts). See wiki/principles/domain.md P-11.

gyro_full_scale_dps.description: Gyroscope full-scale range in degrees/second (e.g. 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000). ASK the user up front. Fixes counts-per-dps. The gyro reads ~0 at rest, so rest gives no gyro scale reference. See wiki/principles/domain.md P-11.

units.description: Per-quantity unit record, e.g. {"acceleration":"g","angular_velocity":"deg/s"}. The platform does not dictate units (values only need to be numeric); record them for downstream sanity.

task_type.description: Fixed at platform solution-creation. Gesture recognition is multiclass_classification.

target_technology.description: Which framework the model will be built with. Axon (LiteRT, on the Axon NPU) accepts ONLY FLOAT32; Neuton accepts INT8/INT16/FLOAT32. Drives the recommended input data type — see wiki/architecture/platform-preprocessing-options.md.

class_encoding.description: Classification target encoding. REQUIRED for classification tasks; omit for regression/anomaly.

map.description: name -> integer index. Must start at 0 and be contiguous (e.g. {"idle":0,"unknown":1,"swipe_left":2}). Save this dictionary; the platform needs >=2 classes and >=20 samples each.

continuous_classes.description: Class indices that are continuous streams (idle/unknown) — trimmed to a window multiple, not centered.

gesture_classes.description: Class indices that are discrete gestures — centered so the motion peak sits mid-window.

window.description: Intended windowing the data must be compatible with (the user sets these in the platform UI; the data-builder only validates compatibility).

candidates.description: One or two candidate window sizes in samples. The CONDITIONAL hard rule (enforced by the validator, not expressible here): if frequency_domain_features is false the window must be in [10,1000]; if true it must be a power of 2 in [128,2048]. The schema bound 10-2048 only spans both cases.

shift.description: Sliding shift in samples. For TRAINING, set shift = window (no overlap) to avoid imbalance; overlap is for inference. Hard rule (validator-enforced): shift cannot exceed the window size. null = unspecified (validator emits an info finding).

frequency_domain_features.description: If true, window must be power-of-2 in 128-2048 and the min contiguous run per class escalates to 128.

signal_processing.description: Whether the platform's Signal Processing (windowing) will be ON for this solution. true = windowed (gesture/activity/regression over a stream); false = tabular (one row = one independent observation, no windowing). Omit if unknown. When false, the validator skips the window-based checks. NO default here on purpose: the platform's own default is off (owner-stated, unconfirmed), and materialising a default would assert a mode the user has not confirmed. See wiki/architecture/platform-signal-processing-applicability.md.

holdout_path.description: Optional path to a holdout/test CSV. Must match the training file's structure and field order, else the platform auto-splits 80/20.
